schema_note: 9 semantic anchor fields + 2 meta. PF idea-clarifier (I1) format. _filled_ratio denominator = 9.

target_user.primary_persona: Curious adult and learning student, single UI, mode auto-detected by Gemma function-call
specific_situation_examples: 어른: '왜 어떤 노래는 들으면 우는지?' (음악·기억의 메타 호기심)
target_user.user_does_NOT_include: 법률·의료·금융 자문이 필요한 사람, 답을 즉시 받아야 하는 사람, 시간에 쫓기는 작업 컨텍스트의 사용자

primary_surface.distribution: DMG (notarized) for hackathon demo, Mac App Store 후보 (post-submission)

load_bearing_features: configurable thinking mode — visible UI element (thought silhouette + word-boundary highlight)
256K context — multi-year wondering log compression and selective injection
native function calling — mode_classify, ask_back, surface_past_wonder, defer_to_human
non_load_bearing_features_used: audio input via E4B (optional; primary STT path is macOS Speech framework)
image input (not in MVP, possible post-MVP for diagram-based wondering)
ai_capability_required.why_gemma4_specifically: Apache 2.0 open weights → Mac App Store 배포 가능, MLX-Swift 직접 추론 → 0 byte cloud, configurable thinking mode → Socratic reasoning 가시화 가능, 128K+ context → 다년 wondering log를 RAG 없이 직접 주입

demo_day_metrics: TTFT (time to first viseme): ≤ 8s on M2/M3, ≤ 12s on M1
STT accuracy on Korean+English mixed: ≥ 90% word accuracy (Speech framework baseline)
Gemma 'answers given' rate: ≤ 5% (95%+ should be re-questions)
user_outcome_metrics: wondering log entries per session: median ≥ 3
next-day re-open rate: not measured in MVP (privacy: no telemetry)
video_metrics: 3-minute YouTube must demonstrate at least 2 personas (adult + student) and at least one 14-month time-jump scene

absolute_rejects: voice cloning of any living person
any cloud network call (App Sandbox: no Outgoing)
automated decisions affecting user rights or welfare
any external dependency that requires runtime download from a non-Apple source

applicable: GDPR (EU users via Mac App Store later)
regulatory_domain.approach: on-device only · 0 byte egress · 사용자 발화 영구 저장은 사용자 명시 동의 시만 · Core Data DB 암호화(File Protection complete) · 학생 모드는 부모/교사 승인 흐름 게이트 + COPPA-compliant 데이터 흐름 다이어그램 SPEC.md에 포함
regulatory_domain.out_of_scope: HIPAA, FDA, 의료기기 등급 — 본 앱은 의료 도구 아님, '소크라테스적 호기심 도구'로 명시

distribution.primary: Direct DMG download from project page (notarized) for hackathon demo
distribution.live_demo: downloadable DMG link in Writeup Attachments

weekly_milestones.goal: SpecDD complete + scaffold MVP loop (STT→Gemma→TTS→viseme) on dummy phrases
real Gemma E4B integration + UI polish + 256K wondering log + video shoot + Writeup

business_model.monetization_post_hackathon: free DMG, Apache 2.0. Mac App Store free tier. Post-MVP: optional 'Voice Pack' DLC (additional TTS voices) at $4.99 if demand.
business_model.sustainability_partner: TBD — candidates: Khan Academy 한국지부 / OER 공동체 / 한국교총 / EduTech 비영리. Submission 전 1개 명명 의무 (BP D3 mitigation)
business_model.ngo_pitch: 오픈소스 + on-device + COPPA-friendly · 학교 디스트릭 무료 배포

_filled_ratio_note: 9/9 fields populated at handoff. SpecDD critics may revise individual fields but full re-fill not required.
